lastCompletedStory.title: Add notify recipient/from steps + API-key status to config wizard

nextStoryContext: ConfigChoices (src/ui/ConfigScreen.tsx) now carries two OPTIONAL string fields, resendRecipient and resendFrom (default '' when the wizard reaches 'done', per useFireOnDone). The flat wizard gained two new WizardStep values appended after 'plan-approval': 'notify-recipient' and 'notify-from' (allSteps order: phases, backend, merge-mode, plan-approval, notify-recipient, notify-from, done -- 11 total confirmations from a fresh wizard, all offsets in BackendSection/MergeModeSection/PlanApprovalSection/NotifyRecipientSection/NotifyFromSection are `PHASE_STEPS.length + N` gates, N=0..4). Both notify steps use the new NotifyTextInput free-text component (mirrors CustomModelInput but a blank Enter is valid and submits '', meaning 'leave unset' -- there is no minimum-length guard unlike CustomModelInput's `if (trimmed === '') return`). RESEND_API_KEY status (✓ configured / ✗ not configured) is rendered read-only inside NotifyRecipientSection via a new ApiKeyStatus component, reading `process.env['RESEND_API_KEY']` directly in ConfigScreen -- there is intentionally NO TextInput for the key anywhere in this file; do not add one. Persistence of resend_recipient/resend_from into [notify] of project.toml (mergeConfigChoices in src/commands/config.ts) is explicitly OUT of scope here and belongs to US-004 ('Persist notify fields to [notify], never the API key'); US-004 should read choices.resendRecipient/choices.resendFrom (both optional, default undefined until the wizard runs) and write only non-empty values to [notify], never resend_api_key past what src/config/models.ts already does for backward-compat. Refactor note: ConfigScreen's function body was extracted into useFireOnDone (the onDone-firing effect) and PhaseStepsSection (the phase .map loop) to stay under biome's noExcessiveLinesPerFunction (80-line) budget -- if US-004 or later touches ConfigScreen again and the function grows, extract further rather than raising the budget.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed TextInput's onSubmit(value) fires on Enter with the current controlled value, including an empty string when the field is untouched -- matches NotifyTextInput's 'blank Enter = leave unset' design; no SDK behavior change needed.
